M-LOG.Purpose: Cross-system logging seam of the framework: the single FlexVerse.Log API with a grep-stable module-marker contract shared by all systems, devtools and the verification evidence pipeline.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Level API: Info, Debug, Warning, Error with module marker as first argument and a semantic event token plus key/value variables.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Module origin prefix and Unity/no-Unity sink selection. Global mode gate Log.Enabled: default-on switch owned by the entry point of the running mode.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Log suppression while enabled — no throttling, no deduplication, no game log caps.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Copying the seam into other mods — the contract exists exactly once.

Principles.PRIN-001: While Log.Enabled is true, a missing line means the event did not happen: the log is never throttled or deduplicated.
Principles.PRIN-002: Debug is hot-path verbosity by design; Info marks milestones only.
Principles.PRIN-003: The log targets automated verification and the agent evidence pipeline; interactive test mods opt out via the mode gate.

Requirements.REQ-001: Every call carries a module marker: Log.Info("M-WIDGET-TREE", ...) — written manually, never derived centrally.
Requirements.REQ-002: Log lines are grep-stable and frostline-schema shaped: [frame][FV][M-module][Class:Method][LEVEL] event VARIABLES: {k=v, ...} — uppercase level, dot-notated event token, mandatory VARIABLES snapshot ({} when empty), no free-text prose.
Requirements.REQ-003: The seam works without Unity present (tests) — Unity is behind the sink, never required.
Requirements.REQ-004: Log.Enabled defaults to true; when false, Emit discards messages before origin resolution and the sink. Only mode entry points toggle it (automated runs keep it on).

Inputs.IN-001: module: string — M-* marker of the owning module; event: dot-notated token; vars: key/value pairs.

Outputs.OUT-001: log line via the default sink (UnityEngine.Debug.Log when Unity is present); nothing when Log.Enabled is false.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Writes to the engine log (Player.log in-game).

M-LOG.Codemap: * `Log.{Info|Debug|Warning|Error}(module, event, vars)` -> `Log.Emit` + `Log.FormatVars` => `Log.Enabled` -> `Log.UnityWrite` * `Log.Origin(module)` => `[FV][M-module][Class:Method][LEVEL] event VARIABLES: {k=v}` * `Log.HasUnityRuntime` => sink selection * `Log` <= `{Info|Debug|Warning|Error}` call sites : all modules * `ExplorerMod` => `Log.Enabled = false` : interactive mode opt-out * `evidence._marker_matches` -> `[FV][M-` : P-FLEXVERSE-TOOLING marker contract
